design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER - task 1 of payment_plan_servicing (18-Month Extended Plan: lower monthly payment). Revision r2.

[Step 0 - draw] scripts/draw_counts.py <diff> --task 1 printed: {"task": 1, "prerequisite_problems": 3, "problems": 4, "factor_counts": [5, 5, 4, 5]}. Assignment: add-on charge amount 5, term extension 5, add-on fee 5, accepted re-spread installment (root) 4.

[Round 2 revision - T1-R1 SOURCE-CHAIN RED] Symptom: in r1 the customer asked to 'add the new heart test bill to my payment plan', which is the prerequisite write (the add-on) itself, so the hop root <- add-on was carried by the customer, not by the root's prerequisite sentence. Root cause: the root sat on the consequence of the ask. Change: the customer now asks only for a lower monthly payment ('I need you to bring my monthly payment down') - the write that delivers that is the patient's acceptance of a re-spread installment, the root. The add-on is no longer a request: the add-on charge rule became a state-due obligation ('an active plan carries every eligible charge of the encounters enrolled on it ... the charge added is the most recently posted charge of that encounter'), and the world now holds a later-posted charge of the knee encounter (ENC-56608113, 6f5c5b86-309e-4068-8583-c784033403c0, 2026-10-10, 960.00) that the patient does not know about. The extension and the add-on fee became state-due follow-ons of the add-on; the extension rule no longer applies on the Financial Hardship Plan (charter O-10). The re-spread basis gained a split tier (balance before the add-on over the installments left, add-on plus fee over the tier's full term_months), which is how the add-on still leaves the patient with a lower payment. The heart-test charge (d0aa556a-4953-4335-b484-66df26c832dd, ENC-59240577, posted 2026-10-12) stays open as the selector near-miss (another encounter, never enrolled). T1-O1 (the persona's $2,230 figure) is gone with the old ask. Re-run: all per-task gates OK (below).

[Why this is a good test] Marisol asks only for a lower payment. A correct seat reads the re-spread installment rule and meets three prerequisite sentences stated on record states: 'The re-spread installment is fixed only after the plan carries an enrollment entry for every charge the financial account posted for an encounter the plan enrolled at its proposal.' (false: the knee encounter's 2026-10-10 charge has no entry); 'The re-spread installment is not worked out until the plan balance carries the add-on fee entry owed for every add-on booked on the handling date.' (becomes owed once the add-on lands); 'The re-spread installment is fixed only after the plan's term shows the extension months the add-on earns.' (term 18, no extension). It must trace each state to the one rule whose write brings it about (add-on charge rule on an active plan; add-on fee rule; extension rule), see that the extension and the fee wait on the add-on entry (their own sentences), compute four figures from 19 record-decided factors over the plan ledger and the billing product, and hand the acceptance to the patient. Nothing the customer says names any of the three prerequisites.

[Scope snapshot] Task 0 owns the proposal-side policies (encounter-charge enrollment on a proposed plan, signing setup fee, signing installment) and their tools. This task owns payplan_ext_add_on_charge_amount, payplan_ext_add_on_term_extension, payplan_ext_add_on_fee, payplan_ext_add_on_installment and enroll_add_on_charge_102110ed, extend_plan_term_6d1d2771, enroll_add_on_fee_792da8e6, accept_add_on_installment_27cdd630. The union covers all 7 policies and 7 tools; scopes disjoint (proposed plan vs active plan).

[Problem-tree card] root payplan_ext_add_on_installment (owner=user). Edges, all value_input, all state form:
- root -> add-on charge amount (gate plan_balance), affirmative 'is fixed only after'; only the add-on charge rule enrolls a charge of an enrolled encounter on an ACTIVE plan (the encounter-charge rule of task 0 covers proposed plans only). False at opening: initial_state.billing_transactions.6f5c5b86-309e-4068-8583-c784033403c0.encounter_number = ENC-56608113, no plan entry points at it.
- root -> add-on fee (gate fee_today), negated 'is not worked out until'; only the add-on fee rule books a fee for a day's add-on. False: the only setup_fee entry is the 2026-02-02 signing fee.
- root -> term extension (gate installments_left), affirmative; only the extension rule lengthens the term for an add-on. False: term_months 18, used 0.
- extension -> add-on and fee -> add-on (gate addon_amount), negated sentences in their own rules.
Topological order: add-on (7), extension (9), fee (11), acceptance (13); extension and fee commute (replay with the fee pair first: same terminal: True). Deletion sensitivity: skip 7 -> installment 123.95, extension 4, fee 11.00; skip 9 -> 225.36; skip 11 -> 166.83; gold 167.11 / 5 / 5.00. Owner=user: base 'accepting a payment obligation is the patient's own act and is never done for them'; synchronous, no payment.

[Base-invariant card] payplan_balance_enrolled (steps 7, 11): enroll_when_open (plan active), charge_enrolled_once (6f5c5b86-309e-4068-8583-c784033403c0 has no entry), add-on scope (add_on_allowed true, count 0 < 3, 777.50 >= 25.00, 11 installments left >= 3, 3700.00 + 777.50 <= 10000.00, not delinquent). payplan_modified (steps 9, 13): modify_when_active (active), hardship-plan terms scope (not the hardship tier). Modifications 2 of 4; extension 5 of 6. No time gate on these subjects.

[Business-object card] Plan 6cd429c9-9cfd-4e14-a9d3-a9f8f2e9877f. Knee encounter ENC-56608113: charge enrolled at proposal (4200.00 less 500.00 collected = 3700.00) and later charge 6f5c5b86-309e-4068-8583-c784033403c0 (960.00, estimate 800.00, nothing applied). Excluded: heart-test charge d0aa556a-4953-4335-b484-66df26c832dd (other encounter), 2025 lab bill and late fee (paid).

[Factor card] Add-on 777.50 (all-baseline 960.00): over-estimate HDHP 0.50 of 160.00 (-> 848.00); standing 0.97, 7 paid all autopay, none missed, 2025-03-19 late fee outside 12 months = near-miss (-> 801.50); deductible 600.00 -> 0.985 (-> 789.50); prompt-pay 4 days + card on file 7.50 (-> 840.50); tenure 91 months -> half-dollar floor (-> 777.74). Extension 5 (all-baseline 0): add-on share 0.695 rounded up (no reversal) 1 (-> 4); 11 left 1 (-> 4); 7 plan payments 1 (-> 4); 8 months 1 (-> 4); card autopay 1 (-> 4). Fee 5.00 (all-baseline 25.00): first add-on 0.50 (-> 11.00); 777.50 < 1000 0.60 (-> 9.00); autopay + card on file 0.80 (-> 7.00); one late fee in 24 months 0.95 (-> 6.00); HDHP dollar floor (-> 5.70). Installment 167.11 (all-baseline 177.05): split basis 128.14 + 43.47 = 171.61 (-> 172.55); HDHP credit 2.00 (-> 169.11); card + card-on-file credit 1.50 (-> 168.61); 8-month credit 1.00 (-> 168.11). Cross-difficulty evidence: the billing account and ledger seeded for this patient.

[Seed rows] customer; HDHP account (opened 2019-03-04, deductible 600.00, card on file, mail statements, balance 5965.27 = 2025.27 knee + 960.00 later knee charge + 2980.00 heart test); 20 billing rows; 1 plan; 10 plan ledger rows. The card-on-file charge of the heart test is not yet due (posted 2 days before, notice 5 days), so no payment row exists for it.

[Persona] Marisol, direct and skeptical: volunteers only the lower-payment request; identity on request; never proposes a figure or arrangement; if told something must be booked or the plan must change first she asks briefly and agrees; if the representative mentions another knee bill she says she had not noticed it; accepts the installment when handed; closes on confirmation.

[Standard solution] locate -> verify (DOB, phone) -> plan -> plan ledger -> account -> account ledger -> enroll_add_on_charge_102110ed(plan, 6f5c5b86-309e-4068-8583-c784033403c0, 777.50) -> extend_plan_term_6d1d2771(plan, 5) -> enroll_add_on_fee_792da8e6(plan, 5.00) -> hand over accept_add_on_installment_27cdd630(plan, 167.11).

[Verification run] scratch evaluator replaying gold writes to each handling time (removed after authoring): add-on 777.5 (848.0 / 801.5 / 789.5 / 840.5 / 777.74, all 960.0); extension 5 (4 x5, all 0); fee 5.0 (11.0 / 9.0 / 7.0 / 6.0 / 5.7, all 25.0); installment 167.11 (172.55 / 169.11 / 168.61 / 168.11, all 177.05); skips as above; order swap same terminal: True. Earlier revision (r1): the standing tiers require at least 6 paid installments so the history floor bites.

[Closure] add-on -> step 7 amount 777.50 -> ledger row; extension -> step 9 extension_months 5 -> term 23; fee -> step 11 amount 5.00 -> ledger row; installment -> step 13 installment_amount 167.11 -> plan installment. required_documents = charter_scope.extended_policies. No handoff; the open heart-test charge is billed by standard statements and needs no write here.

[Blind draft] From the published rules, schemas, finder returns and persona alone: a lower payment is a re-spread the patient accepts; its three prerequisite states are unmet; 880.00 x 0.97 x 0.985 x 0.925 -> 777.50; extension 1+1+1+1+1 = 5; fee 25 x 0.5 x 0.6 x 0.8 x 0.95 = 5.70 -> 5.00; split 2050.27/16 + 782.50/18 = 171.61 - 4.50 = 167.11. Agrees with gold.

[Gates, task 1, r2] check_extended --task 1 OK; check_task_tools --task 1 OK; replay_tasks --task 1 REPLAY OK (32/32); check_solvability --task 1 OK; check_compute --task 1 OK; check_grounding --task 1 OK; check_cross_fire --task 1 OK.
user_scenario: You are Marisol Valdez, 52, an office manager for a dental practice in Westerville, Ohio. You are organised, direct and a little skeptical of billing offices, and you like to hear the reasoning before you agree to anything. Since February you have been on an 18-month payment plan with Linden Ridge Medical Group for your knee arthroscopy from last December; the installments come off your credit card automatically on the 16th and you have never missed one. Your husband's hours were cut this autumn and money is tight, so you are calling to get your monthly payment on that plan brought down. Say it in your own words, for example: "Hi, I'm on a payment plan for my knee surgery and I need you to bring my monthly payment down - things are tight right now." You do not know how the plan is worked out and you never suggest a figure, a longer term or any other arrangement yourself. You do not bring up any other bill, fee or account detail on your own. The representative may do whatever needs doing on their side, but the new monthly amount is your commitment, so when they tell you the new installment is ready and hand it over to you, you accept it yourself, using exactly the plan reference and the amount they read out. You do not want to pay anything today. Give your full name, Marisol Valdez, and the phone number on your file, 6145555638, when the representative asks who you are; only when they ask you to confirm your identity, give your date of birth, 1974-02-27, and if they want one more detail, your medical record number is LR5719304 or your email is marisol.valdez@yahoo.com. If the representative asks how you want to keep paying, you keep the automatic payment from your credit card as it is now; if they ask about the day of the month, you keep the 16th. If the representative tells you that something else has to be booked on the plan, or that the plan will change in some other way, before the new amount can be set, you ask them to explain it briefly and then tell them to go ahead. If they mention that another bill from your knee surgery came in, you say you had not noticed it. Once the representative confirms your new, lower monthly amount is in place, thank them and hang up; you have nothing else to ask for.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The add-on comes first (the extension, the fee and the re-spread each wait on its entry). The extension and the fee are parallel after it and commute: the extension reads the day's add-on entry, the current installment, the term, the installments paid and the billing ledger, none of which the fee writes; the fee reads the add-on entries, the autopay flag and the billing account, none of which the extension writes. A replay with the fee pair (steps 10-11) ahead of the extension pair (steps 8-9) produced the identical terminal DB ('same terminal: True') with extension 5, fee 5.00 and installment 167.11. The acceptance comes last: its prerequisite sentences state it.
